text: This report recommends the appointment of a public member nominated by the Forest Hill Skating Club to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Arena Board.

The North York Community Council: 1. Appointed Blair Naiberg as the member nominated by the Forest Hill Skating Club to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on January 25, 2028, and until a successor is appointed.
